svg.title: A formatting toolbar over markdown — SoftTrack web design mockup (#118)
svg.desc: MarkdownEditor gains a toolbar (text style, bold, italic, strikethrough, lists, link, quote, code, indent) plus a markdown help button beside Preview. Buttons wrap or unwrap the selection; ⌘B, ⌘I and ⌘K are the fast path; compact editors keep the rest behind ⋯.
svg.text: · the textarea stays the source of truth; the toolbar writes markdown for you
Editing a description on the ticket page
full toolbar; the properties column is cropped out

svg.text: Wrap, keep the caret inside, unwrap

g.text: undoes each step. The mention menu and paste-to-upload switch to it too.
Looks right. Can you add the Safari 17 case to ENG-45?
No underline, fonts, sizes or colours: markdown has no way to store
them, and the stored format stays markdown.

svg.text: One toolbar in MarkdownEditor, so the description, the comment box and the new-ticket modal all get it. Not WYSIWYG: the textarea and Preview stay, and remarkMentions,
remarkIssueKeys, the Jira importer’s output, history diffs and toggleTaskAtOffset keep working on the same markdown. Tables stay out, for their own issue.
